Verses.16: We know what love is because He laid down His life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for one another.
Verses.17: But whoever has worldly goods and sees a child of God in need, and closes their heart to them, how does the love of God remain in them?
Verses.18: Dear children, let us not love in words or speech, but with actions and in truth.
Verses.19: In this way we know that we are of the truth, and will set our hearts at ease before Him.
Verses.20: If our hearts condemn us, we know that God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.

Changes: 2024-06-05 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 16-20.
